instruction: Create an HTML file named 'index.html' at '/home/user/Desktop' in VS Code with a title tag set to 'My Page'.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully created test.py on Desktop via VS Code using Ctrl+N, Ctrl+Shift+S Save As dialog, navigated to Desktop folder, typed filename, and saved in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can use VS Code keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+N, Ctrl+Shift+S), navigate Save As dialog, select folders, type filenames, and click Save button.
metadata.task_rationale: Extends the file-creation task by requiring the agent to also write HTML content with a specific title tag before saving, testing both file creation and content editing capabilities.
metadata.explanation: Task requires creating index.html on Desktop with a <title>My Page</title> tag. Custom getter reads the file from VM and extracts the title. Custom metric awards 0.5 for file existence and 0.5 for correct title, enabling partial credit.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the file at /home/user/Desktop/index.html from the VM and extracts the <title> tag content via regex, returning structured {exists, content, title} data.
Metric correctly handles the expected parameter as the rules dict directly (expected.get('expected_title')), consistent with get_rule returning config['rules'].
Partial credit scoring (0.5 file existence + 0.5 correct title) is well-designed and covers both instruction requirements: file creation and title content.
Minor note: title comparison is case-insensitive (.lower()), which is slightly lenient but reasonable for HTML title verification.
